description:
Single storey front extension incorporating porch; Conversion of garage to habitable room, Replace garage door with window in front elevation; Single storey side extension; Single storey rear extension; Installation of
Juliette balcony to rear dormer; Roof lights in side roof slopes; External alterations
(Demolition of side extension and shed)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Flood risk assessment, Ecological Appraisal, Reasonable exception statement, design access and heritage statement, PL-A-03, Permeable paving maintenance plan and Mitigation measures, PL-A-01, PL-A-02 rev A.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Prior to the commencement of construction, a scale, colour plan of biodiversity enhancements on the site, to include the number, specification, and location of enhancements such as bat and bird boxes, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter, the biodiversity enhancement measures shall be carried out and retained in accordance with the approved details.

<p>No external lighting shall be installed on the extensions or roof alterations hereby permitted unless full details of a lighting scheme are submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include details of the exact location, height, design, and intensity of the lights, and shall be designed to prevent light spillage onto nearby habitat suitable for bats. The lighting shall be installed and operated strictly in accordance with the approved details.</p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p>No development shall take place (including vegetation/site clearance) until a Precautionary Working Method Statement (PWMS) for bats, birds, herptiles, badgers, and hedgehogs has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The PWMS should include, but may not be limited to; A toolbox talk covering the ecology of and legislation which protects species which may be present on site, to be delivered to construction personnel by the ECoW; Timing details for the close inspection of the lifted tile feature by a licenced bat worker (the results of which must later be submitted to the council);A plan showing areas of sensitivity and exclusion zones; Details of where and how waste and/or construction materials will be stored; Details of mitigation measures required for protected species, such as herptile fencing; Details of which construction tasks pose a risk to protected species, and will therefore be supervised by the ECoW; Measures for supervised vegetation clearance (e.g., phased, directional cut); Guidance on sensitive roof strip techniques; and Procedures to be followed if a protected species is discovered. The approved PWMS shall be implemented in full according to the specified timescales, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.</p>
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
